 Fandango November 2026 Streaming Lineup Announced
 By Mirko Parlevliet 
 October 27, 2026 October 27, 2026 
 The Fandango November 2026 streaming lineup has been announced and features new transactional video-on-demand (TVOD) multi-studio franchise bundles, anticipated digital releases, and a slate of free ad-supported streaming (AVOD) titles spanning blockbuster cinema, family entertainment, and acclaimed classics.
 On TVOD, Fandango continues to expand its multi-studio bundle offerings with new franchise-wide collections featuring The Terminator , Vin Diesel’s xXx , Pacific Rim , My Big Fat Greek Wedding , and Highlander . Exclusive bundles are also expected to be discounted for the first time as part of Fandango’s Black Friday campaign, giving fans new opportunities to build their digital movie collections.
 Additional November highlights include the digital debut of The Odyssey on November 17, a preorder on a “Zach Cregger/Resident Evil” cross-studio bundle bringing together Barbarian , Weapons , and Resident Evil (2026), and a “Dog Heroes/Man’s Best Friend” bundle with Heart of the Beast , Arthur the King , and Megan Leavey .
 The Fandango November 2026 AVOD lineup features several platform debuts, including Godzilla (1998), timed to the theatrical release of Godzilla Minus Zero ; Gladiator ; and The Departed , which celebrates its 20th anniversary. The slate also offers a robust selection of family and Thanksgiving favorites.
 Fandango will serve as the exclusive free streaming home for Trolls Band Together , Migration , The Fablemans , Fast X , and Ruby Gillman, Teenage Kraken throughout November. Additional highlights include Sweet Home Alabama, Free Birds, The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader, and The Princess Bride.
 November highlights also include Three Kings and The Thin Red Line for Veterans Day, the complete first season of Anna Pigeon streaming free beginning November 8, and The Rainmaker, with Season 1 available free as new Season 2 episodes premiere weekly.
